sections.heading: Frequently asked Questions
sections.text: Frequently asked Questions 1. What is the LiveIn Orthopedic Memory Foam Mattress? TThe LiveIn Orthopedic Memory Foam Mattress is a roll-packed adaptive memory foam orthopedic medium firm mattress designed with a combination of orthopedic support foam and memory foam, finished with triple anti-microbial fabric to support healthy, comfortable sleep. It’s part of Duroflex’s Duropedic range, which is doctor-recommended for targeted support and exclusively approved by the National Health Academy. 2. What problem does LiveIn Orthopedic Memory Foam Mattress solve? This mattress addresses three core sleep challenges: poor spinal alignment, orthopedic discomfort, and hygiene concerns. The certified 5-zone orthopedic layer encourages proper spinal alignment and postural correction, making it ideal for those experiencing back or neck issues. The triple anti-microbial fabric shields against bacteria, fungi, and dust mites, ensuring a cleaner, healthier sleep surface. The adaptive memory foam cradles pressure points, providing relief for those with pain-related sleep disruption. 3. Who is LiveIn Orthopedic Memory Foam Mattress best for? This mattress is designed for individuals who prioritize health and comfort. It's ideal for people experiencing back pain, those seeking postural correction, individuals with dust allergies or microbial sensitivities, and anyone wanting a premium, doctor recommended sleep solution delivered conveniently. 4. How does the LiveIn Orthopedic Memory Foam Mattress work? The orthopedic support foam provides a firm, stable base that helps maintain proper spinal alignment, while the memory foam layer contours to the body to reduce pressure points and enhance comfort. Delivered in a compact roll-packed box, the mattress is designed for easy DIY setup; simply unroll it, allow it to expand, and it gradually regains its full shape. 5. How is it different from alternatives? Unlike regular foam mattresses, this mattress combines orthopedic-grade firmness with memory foam comfort and includes triple anti-microbial fabric, making it more supportive and hygienic than standard foam options. The proprietary 5-zone orthopedic technology provides region-specific support, more advanced than basic orthopedic mattresses. 6. What warranty does this mattress come with? The LiveIn Orthopedic Memory Foam Mattress comes with a 10-year conditional manufacturer warranty, covering manufacturing defects as per brand terms. 7. How does the LiveIn Orthopedic Memory Foam Mattress feel? The LiveIn Orthopedic Memory Foam Mattress has a medium-firm orthopedic feel that provides strong support for the back and spine. 8. How to take care of this mattress? Always use a mattress protector to protect against dust, spills, and allergens, and get it professionally deep-cleaned twice a year for better hygiene. Do not flip or turn the mattress, avoid ironing on it, and never fold or bend it as it may damage the mattress structure.
